'''{{{1|{{PAGENAME}}}}}''' is within the scope of [[Wookieepedia:WookieeProject Women|'''WookieeProject: Women''']], an effort to develop and maintain [[in-universe]] articles about [[Canon]] and [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] characters who are women and out-of-universe articles about female ''[[Star Wars]]'' contributors, as well as those characters who use she/her pronouns.<br/><br/> If you would like to participate, you can edit the article attached to this notice or visit our [[Wookieepedia:WookieeProject Women|project page]], where you can join the project and contribute to the discussion.}}<noinclude>
